text: This report will outline the proposed amendments to the Financial Authorities By-law 2-2010 recommended for the approval of the Board of Management.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the Financial Authorities By-law 2-2019 in Appendix I to the report (March 31, 2019) from the Director, Finance and Computer Services, Toronto Zoo.
